text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(This time, I'm gonna say it fer sure...!
If I'm a real "City Gal", somethin' like this should be—)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, then why don't you
just go hang out together?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Take them out to some trendy, "City Gal"-style place
and treat them to a meal. Y'know, like a casual date.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: D-D-D-D-D-Date?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A d-date is like... that thing... where two folks
who fancy each other go out... j-just the two of 'em...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
No, no... don't make it so serious...
Friends do it all the time... Hey, are you listening?? Hellooo?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(A-A date with Trainer...
Is that really just normal stuff fer "City Gals"?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Tr-Trainer! Um, tomorrow...
Ah, augh... er... umm...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's nothin' at all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Haaah... Blew it again. How many times have I
chickened out now...? I'm so jittery I can't ask 'em at all...)

...The same thing has happened several times over the past few days.
It must be related to that thing she wants to tell me.

Maybe a formal setting makes it too hard for her to open up.
With that in mind—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Let's go have some fun today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Why am *I* the one bein' invited?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer said it was fer a change of pace, but
at this rate...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, no use frettin' about it! Since they went outta their way
to invite me, the least I can do is act like a proper "City Gal"—)
choice_data_list: Have you ever played darts before?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Never have... But these hands're forged by snowball fights!
First, ya stare down the target, and squeeze the snowball tight!!
choice_data_list: It's a dart! An arrow! Don't squeeze it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gah! R-Right, of course. Heh, hehe...
Just got a little jittery! A-Alright, here goes...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Why didn't it hit...?! Well, I mean,
it hit somethin', but...
choice_data_list: I didn't expect it to hit the target next to us...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank goodness nobody was there...
Ugh, I almost caused a whole heap of trouble...

She still seems extremely tense, her shoulders stiff.
I call out to her cheerfully to help her relax and enjoy herself.
choice_data_list: Just relax your shoulders and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, sir...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(U-Ugh... I'm awful sorry...
I'm just makin' Trainer worry about me...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(This time fer sure... like a true "City Gal",
I'm gonna order real smart and cool!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(The name's a real tongue-twister, but
now that I've mastered standard Tokyo speech, I got this...!)
choice_data_list: I'll have the Honey Pitaya Fresh S—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! I'll do the orderin'!
Excuse me, could we get—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Two hunny pitata frash soothies, please!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I bit my tongue--!! Totally butchered it, no hidin' that!!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: U-Um... what I meant was...
choice_data_list: It's a tough one to say.
It's a tough one to say, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (! Makin' 'em cover fer me again...?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, what am I even doin'...
At this rate... I'm not even close...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's the lipstick City-san was in the ad for...
Look at all those shades... They're mighty pretty...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(...I want it, but...
I ain't earned the right to wear somethin' like that yet.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: Want to pick one out together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... N-No, no, no! I was just lookin'!
Somethin' like that's... well, way too early fer me...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... I can't even ask 'em on a date,
or order smartly at a fancy cafe.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm miles away from bein' a real "City Gal"...
Someone like me...)

Yukino Bijin looks terribly downcast.
Her remark about it being "way too early" weighs on my mind.

I brought her to places she'd enjoy to make it easier
for her to open up about whatever's on her mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*...

The mood doesn't feel right for her to talk.
Still, I can't just leave her like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I had a great time thanks to you, Yukino!

text_block_list.text:
Hoping to lift her spirits, I tell her with a smile.
Her eyes widen—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
F-Fer real?!
I-Is that so... Ya really had fun...?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Nothin' went right, but
Trainer still had a good time...?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I messed up... as long as they had fun,
I'll call today a win! Just fer today, mind ya!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-The pleasure was all mine, thank ya so much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I'll be fine! I'll still get a chance fer "revenge"!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I might not be able to do everythin' all at once...
but next time, fer sure! At least I'll ask 'em on a date myself...!)

Her expression seems to have brightened a little.
Seeing Yukino Bijin looking forward again, I breathe a sigh of relief.
